hawza.title: Hawza Um Al-Banin Online Seminary
hawza.short: One platform for exams and membership verification
hawza.desc: A complete e-learning platform for a women’s seminary: student enrollment, daily audio lessons, verified attendance, auto-graded exams, and graduation certificates — fully in Arabic.
hawza.intro: An online women’s seminary teaching across four academic levels. They needed one platform to hold all of it: from the application form, through the daily lesson and attendance, to the exam, the grade, and the certificate — without the administration falling back on paper and chat groups.
hawza.meta_title: Hawza Um Al-Banin — Online Seminary & Exam Platform | EL8
hawza.meta_desc: An e-learning platform for a women’s seminary built by EL8: student enrollment, audio lessons, verified daily attendance, auto-graded exams, and digital certificates. Web, Android, and Windows.

exams.title: Exam administration
exams.desc: A dashboard to create and run examinations across four academic levels.

grading.title: Automatic grading
grading.desc: Scores calculated automatically, with mid-term and final results merged into a cumulative record.

certificates.title: Certificate issuance
certificates.desc: Customisable digital certificates issued to graduates straight from the platform.

raqeem.title: Raqeem Labs
raqeem.short: Interactive science labs for sixth-year science students
raqeem.desc: Over 50 interactive experiments drawn from the complete sixth-year science curriculum — physics and chemistry — running on mobile and offline, fully in Arabic.
raqeem.intro: Not every school can equip a lab with instruments and materials. Raqeem takes the entire sixth-year science syllabus and turns its experiments into interactive simulations on screen: the student controls the variables and sees the result immediately. Over 50 experiments, running on a phone and even with no connection.
raqeem.meta_title: Raqeem Labs — 50+ Interactive Experiments for the Sixth-Year Science Curriculum | EL8
raqeem.meta_desc: Interactive science labs built by EL8 for sixth-year science students: over 50 physics and chemistry experiments drawn from the syllabus, running on mobile and offline, in Arabic.

curriculum.title: The full sixth-year syllabus
curriculum.desc: Experiments are taken chapter by chapter from the set textbook, not generic simulations detached from it.

experiments.title: Over 50 experiments
experiments.desc: Physics and chemistry, each one an interactive simulation with the science explained alongside.

mobile.title: Runs on a phone
mobile.desc: Built mobile-first, so a student can repeat the experiment on their own device with no computer needed.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.desc: The lab runs fully without a connection, so a class never stops because the network dropped.

performance.title: Smooth performance
performance.desc: Canvas and WebGL graphics tuned to run even on older school hardware.

arabic.title: Arabic throughout
arabic.desc: Copy, direction and scientific terminology are native Arabic, not a bolted-on translation.
